requirement.normalizedRequirement: Determine blade_failure_load_F_ex_kN by an approved non-linear stress analysis OR compute F_ex = 300*c*t^2*sigma_ref1/(0.8*D - 2*r), where sigma_ref1 = 0.6*sigma_0.2 + 0.4*sigma_u. Apply the load at 0.8R in the weakest direction. blade_failure_status = failed IF blade_tip_offset_m > 0.10*propeller_diameter_m.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The ultimate load resulting from blade failure by plastic bending around the blade root shall be calculated using F_ex = 300*c*t^2*sigma_ref1/(0.8*D - 2*r) [kN] (6.35), or by an appropriate stress analysis reflecting the non-linear plastic material behaviour of the actual blade. The load is assumed to act at radius 0.8R in the weakest blade direction. A blade is regarded as failed if the tip offset exceeds 10% of propeller diameter D. Use sigma_ref1 = 0.6*sigma_0.2 + 0.4*sigma_u [MPa], with c, t and r representing the actual chord length, maximum thickness, and cylindrical-root radius of the weakest section outside the root fillet.
